turns.text: Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
Not when it's my son. Was he heard before you entered it?
Like, actually tired. Do you sleep? Do you dream?
I'm sorry? You asked for this meeting. Owen.
I ask because you said you came straight from court and you haven't once sounded tired.
I never said court. You have twenty minutes of my time and you've shown me nothing. What's the basis for the zero?
